text:
carla_ng: FYI team — Stratus Health SI is blocked on the last-mile network constraints for their Private deployment. Need a quick arch review this afternoon. They hit two things: image pull failures from our marketplace image and intermittent egress to our telemetry endpoint. :grimacing:

mike_j: on it. ping me the customer VPC details and the marketplace image name. I can join a call at 3pm PT. :calendar:

chen_wang: quick note — their infra team said image pull fails with 403 from our registry. likely auth or signed-image provenance mismatch. we recently rotated the signing key for marketplace images last week.

kevin_p: @carla_ng can you confirm whether they're using the AWS privatelink path or a NAT egress? If they're using VPC-only endpoints we may need to whitelist the registry endpoint in the endpoint policy.

carla_ng: they're on-prem VPC via partner-managed VPN into our dedicated region. no privatelink. customer provided VPC CIDR 10.44.0.0/16 and says all outbound egress is forced through an NGFW.

luca_s: NGFW probably blocking the signature verification callback to signing-service.redwood-infer.internal:443. Also double-check DNS for our registry domain — replaced CNAME last month. Here's the quick checklist I ran:
```
# quick triage commands the customer ran
curl -v https://registry.redwood-infer.example/v2/  # got 403
nslookup registry.redwood-infer.example -> 10.100.50.12
traceroute registry.redwood-infer.example
```

mike_j: thanks Luca. If NGFW is doing TLS inspection it could break sig verification. Ask them to allow passthrough for registry and signing-service hosts, or add an allow rule for the specific FQDNs.

kevin_p: also confirm their TLS fingerprints. If they're pinning, the new CNAME might cause mismatch. We can temporarily re-add old CNAMES for compatibility window if needed.

carla_ng: I'm scheduling a 3pm PT call with Stratus SI and their field engineer. Who can join for a 20m runbook walkthrough? 

mike_j: I'll be on the call. planning to bring the fallback: 1) temp NAT route to public egress, 2) signed-image bundle (scp) we can push to their local registry, 3) quick K8s imagePullSecrets workaround.

chen_wang: I can join too. I'll bring the signed-image bundle instructions and the verification logs.

luca_s: I can stay for the first 10 mins to confirm registry DNS and signing-service reachability.

deploy-bot: deploy 1972.512345 completed to staging — no errors. (irrelevant to this thread, ignore) :robot_face:

carla_ng: perfect. I'll DM the call link and share the customer's environment snippets. After the call we'll capture a short runbook so field can proceed without us. :thumbsup:

mike_j: sj — one more ask: if we need to push an image bundle, please attach the SHA and build tag in the channel before we hand off to SI.

carla_ng: noted. attaching artifact info after call. thanks everyone. :pray:
